title: Denpa Shounen-teki Game
overview: Denpa Shounen Teki Game is a multiplayer party game based on the Nippon TV variety program Susume! Denpa Shōnen. It includes 10 different mini-games such as a tree-climbing game and a whack-a-mole game, and up to seven players can participate simultaneously. The main game mode includes a so-called "batsu game" (punishment game) feature where the losing player must do something embarrassing, such as answer a personal question or kiss the person next to them. There is also a single-player practice mode where the player can choose any of the mini-games to freely play.
